name: GPU Stream Compaction with Scan
definition: Performs stream compaction on GPU by first converting input to a binary mask, running the work-efficient scan on the mask, and scattering non-zero elements to their computed indices.
summary: GPU Stream Compaction with Scan filters arrays by mapping values to a binary mask, computing an exclusive prefix sum for indices, and scattering retained elements, leveraging parallel architecture for over 4x speedup.
